requirements.evidence: Migrations match the spec: entities slug unique 'entities_slug_unique' + softDeletes (create_entities_table.php:13-17); memberships with cascading FKs, role default 'employee', storedAs owner_seq "CASE WHEN role = 'owner' THEN 1 END" and unique indexes 'entity_memberships_entity_user_unique' / 'entity_memberships_one_owner' (create_entity_memberships_table.php:13-21). Models/enum/factories/policies follow the contract (Entity.php:23-43, EntityMembership.php:67-97, UserRole.php:153-156, User.php:117-132). Policy logic matches the rules, including that owner membership can never be deleted and self-removal is allowed (EntityMembershipPolicy.php:22-33). Edge case: membership policies dereference $membership->entity, which is null when the entity is soft-deleted (EntityMembershipPolicy.php:13,36), so those calls would fatal.

conventions.evidence: No Pest tests at all even though conventions say 'No production code without a test'. CHANGELOG.md is not updated under [Unreleased]. docs/database-schema.md is updated correctly (lines 447-479). $fillable is set via #[Fillable]. Policies are registered via Gate::policy (AppServiceProvider.php:44-45).

security.evidence: Policies deny non-members by default (EntityPolicy.php:49-64 returns false when the membership is null), owner deletion is blocked first (EntityMembershipPolicy.php:24-26), and #[Fillable] is used deliberately. EntityMembership has 'role' fillable, which is acceptable for a model but leaves role writes guarded only by future actions. No exploitable flaw is in scope.

tests.evidence: The diff contains no test files: nothing under tests/ for the migrations, the one-owner DB constraint, the factories or the policy rules.

simplicity.evidence: Lean, direct Eloquent code. The member lookup and the isOwnerOrAdmin helper are duplicated across EntityPolicy.php:47-65 and EntityMembershipPolicy.php:197-203; User::membershipFor (User.php:129-132) exists but is not reused there.

readability.evidence: Clear names and small methods. Return types are inconsistent: Entity::memberships/users/owner (Entity.php:28,33,40) and the scope methods (EntityMembership.php:84-97) have no return types, while sibling relations in EntityMembership/User are typed.

scope.evidence: Only the models, enum, policies, factories, migrations, policy registration and the schema doc changed. The doc removes owner_membership_id/locale_default from the entities diagram to match what is implemented (database-schema.md:447-448). No routes, UI or session code.

issues.explanation: Nothing tests the migrations, the DB-level one-owner constraint, the factories or either policy, which breaks the mandatory test-first convention.
The conventions require a CHANGELOG entry under [Unreleased]; none was added.
$membership->entity is null for a soft-deleted entity, so view/assignRole/delete would throw instead of returning false.
The membership lookup and owner/admin check are duplicated in both policies instead of reusing User::membershipFor.
Relations and scopes lack return types, unlike the typed relations in User and EntityMembership.
The doc says the index enforces 'exactly one owner', but the unique index only guarantees at most one.

review.summary: The change adds the entities/entity_memberships migrations with the portable generated-column one-owner constraint, the models, enum, factories and both policies, and it updates the schema doc. The implementation matches the contract and the authorization rules well. However, it ships no tests at all in a project that requires TDD, and it skips the CHANGELOG, so it needs changes before merging.
